result:
I fixed 12 rules. After the fixes, every rule (1–150) matches the price its docstring describes on about 1,000 sample combinations of quantity and unit price. I also confirmed negative input still raises `ValueError`.

| Rule | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 02 | Discount was rounded with `round` (the module docstring says round down to the won) | Changed to `// 100` |
| 14, 72, 102, 109 | Discount started one unit late (101, 51, 6, 6) | Starts at 100, 50, 5, 5 |
| 57, 94 | Discount started at 31 instead of 30 (`>= 31`, `> 30`) | Changed to `>= 30`. Prices don't change: at exactly 30 units these rules give a 0 discount either way |
| 58, 84, 116 | The cap limited the price instead of the discount | Calculate the discount first, then cap the discount |
| 79 | Discount was 4% instead of 3% | Changed to 3% |
| 128 | Docstring says "marginal" but the discount was on the whole amount | Discount now applies only to units above 10: `(qty - 10) * unit` |

STATUS: DONE
